meta.title: Borrow Swiss francs against crypto, gold or shares | Frankencoin
meta.description: Mint ZCHF against BTC, ETH, tokenized gold or Swiss shares and keep your exposure. Live loan-to-value and rates for every collateral.

hero.title: Borrow francs. Keep your BTC, ETH, gold or shares.
hero.subtitle: Deposit collateral, mint Swiss francs, repay when you want your collateral back. No credit check, no counterparty: the terms are on-chain and fixed when you open the position.

rates.title: Live terms per collateral
rates.subtitle: Best open terms right now. Loan-to-value is the liquidation price divided by today's market price.
rates.empty: Live terms are unavailable right now. See them in the app.
rates.note: Interest is the effective yearly rate on what you receive, paid upfront for the whole term. Part of the minted amount is held as a reserve and returned when you repay.

cards.title: 1 · Deposit
cards.description: Pick a collateral and lock it in your own position contract. It stays there, visible on-chain.

cards.title: 2 · Mint
cards.description: Choose amount and term. You receive ZCHF minus upfront interest and a retained reserve that comes back when you repay.

cards.title: 3 · Repay
cards.description: Return the ZCHF any time before maturity to unlock your collateral. Roll over to extend.

items.title: Liquidation price
items.description: If the collateral's market price falls below it, anyone can challenge the position and part of the collateral is auctioned.

items.title: Loan-to-value
items.description: How much you borrow relative to the collateral's market value. Lower is safer.

items.title: Upfront interest
items.description: Paid once when you mint, for the whole term. No variable rate surprises.

items.title: Retained reserve
items.description: A share of what you mint stays in the reserve. You get it back when you repay.

items.title: BTC and ETH
items.description: Wrapped and staked versions such as WBTC, cbBTC, WETH and wstETH.

items.title: Tokenized gold
items.description: Gold tokens such as XAUt and PAXG.

items.title: Tokenized equities
items.description: Swiss company shares issued on-chain, and tokenized index funds.

items.title: Liquidation
items.description: If prices fall through your liquidation price, part of your collateral can be sold at auction. Keep a buffer.

items.title: Maturity
items.description: Each position has an end date. Repay or roll over before it, or the position can be liquidated.

faq.q: My token is not listed. Can it be?
faq.a: Token issuers can [propose a new collateral](/integrate/collateral).
